title: Murdo's Magic
description: A (not literally) magical mod, for you to explore! More to come.
body:
Do you like fun, explorable dimension mods? Well, look no further if you have a second, because this may quell that desire! 

Note: This mod uses textures from the [Opulence](https://modrinth.com/mod/opulence) mod, created by [Pipsqueak737](https://modrinth.com/user/Pipsqueak737)

This mod includes:

# Iksum Bobus Dimension
The Iksum Bobus Dimension is a dimension that you can access via the Iksum Bobus portal. The portal is the same as a nether portal in shape, but it requires Eeple Gem Blocks where obsidian would be. These "Eeeple gems" can be found in the end dimension, embedded in ores in the outer and inner end islands! You must smelt the rough eeple gems and collect 10 blocks worth to go!


 
# Alpha Dimension
The Alpha Dimension is muh pride and joy

it contains many (4) structures that give off the same sort of energy as old minecraft versions. A lot of this dimension is... still in development, but i really wanted to set up this Modrinth page.

anyhow - have fun.

 - Murdo the third-o
